Fang's attire during combat operations.
Lightweight and durable, it satisfies the needs of all field missions.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
She rushes about the frontlines from dawn till dusk, her gait never faltering.
The sweat of today will become the hopes and smiles of tomorrow. She has never stopped yearning for a brighter future.

skins.name: A Pure Pianissimo
skins.content: Fang the Fire-Sharpened's performance outfit for holiday celebrations/A Pure Pianissimo. The black-and-white performance wear is outlined with neat contours. It is a design Fang is fond of, a symbol of the festive melody she is about to compose.
skins.usage: One of Fang the Fire-Sharpened's casual outfits.
skins.quote: This gentle melody, she gives to her fellow teammates, her gathered friends, and to all who hope for a peaceful holiday season.
